Talk at SIG 3D Plenary Session

Jan Klimke, member of the HPI Computer Graphics Systems group and member of the HPI Research School on Service-oriented Computing, gave a talk on “Service-based interactive 3D Visualization of massive 3D City Models on Thin Clients” at the Plenary Session of the Special Interest Group 3D (SIG3D), which was held at the Hamburg Surveying and Geoinformation Agency on October 14th, 2011.
